scope: Exact verify subprocess only; closed constant code/status JSON, no stderr publication; original FAIL/timeouts/assertions retained; O_EXCL|NOFOLLOW0600 existing private admit dir; only exact extra SAFE upload
control_source:
import ast,contextlib,io,json,os,re,stat,subprocess,tempfile,textwrap,types
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/workspace/rutcampustrack')
source=(root/'.github/workflows/ci.yml').read_text()
block=source.split("python3 - <<'PY_RECOVERY'",1)[1].split('          PY_RECOVERY',1)[0]
tree=ast.parse(textwrap.dedent(block))
selected=[node for node in tree.body if isinstance(node,ast.FunctionDef) and node.name in {'verify_failure','call'}]
assert len(selected)==2
code=compile(ast.fix_missing_locations(ast.Module(body=selected,type_ignores=[])),'actual-workflow-helpers','exec')
marker='SYNTHETIC_PRIVATE_TOKEN_NOT_FOR_ARTIFACTS'
results=[]
os.umask(0o077)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='rct-recovery-diagnostic-controls-',dir='/tmp') as directory:
    work=Path(directory)
    (work/'artifacts'/'admit').mkdir(parents=True,mode=0o700)
    path=work/'artifacts'/'admit'/'verification.safe.json'
    ns={'root':root,'work':work,'os':os,'json':json,'re':re,'subprocess':subprocess}
    exec(code,ns)
    cases=[(b'FAIL application recovery: Timed out waiting for restored real participants\n','PARTICIPANT_TIMEOUT',0),
           (b'FAIL application recovery: Exact HTTP replay changed business state/history\n','REPLAY_DATA',0),
           (b'FAIL application recovery: Restored canonical lessons changed\n','CANONICAL_STATE',0),
           (b'FAIL application recovery: Application HTTP request failed with status 403\n','HTTP_STATUS',403),
           (b'FAIL application recovery: KeyError\n','KEY_ERROR',0),
           (('FAIL application recovery: '+marker+'\n').encode(),'OTHER',0),
           (('FAIL application recovery: KeyError\n'+marker).encode(),'OTHER',0),
           (('prefix '+marker+' FAIL application recovery: KeyError').encode(),'OTHER',0),
           (b'FAIL application recovery: Application HTTP request failed with status 999\n','OTHER',0),
           (b'FAIL application recovery: KeyError\n\n','OTHER',0),
           (b'X'*65537,'OTHER',0),(b'\xff','OTHER',0)]
    for data,cause,status in cases:
        ns['verify_failure'](data)
        public=path.read_bytes();value=json.loads(public)
        assert value=={'stage':'APPLICATION_VERIFY','cause':cause,'httpStatus':status}
        assert marker.encode() not in public and len(public)<160 and stat.S_IMODE(path.stat().st_mode)==0o600
        path.unlink()
    ns['verify_failure'](marker.encode(),timed_out=True)
    assert json.loads(path.read_text())['cause']=='COMMAND_TIMEOUT';path.unlink()
    # Existing-file and symlink failures must retain prior data and never follow the link.
    path.write_text(marker)
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):ns['verify_failure'](b'')
    assert path.read_text()==marker;path.unlink()
    target=work/'target.private';target.write_text(marker);path.symlink_to(target)
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):ns['verify_failure'](b'')
    assert target.read_text()==marker;path.unlink()
    class FakeProcess:
        PIPE=-1
        TimeoutExpired=subprocess.TimeoutExpired
        def __init__(self,timeout=False,success=False):self.timeout,self.success=timeout,success
        def run(self,*args,**kwargs):
            if self.timeout:raise self.TimeoutExpired(args[0],kwargs['timeout'])
            return types.SimpleNamespace(returncode=0 if self.success else 1,stdout=b'UNCHANGED_SUCCESS',stderr=b'FAIL application recovery: Application endpoint unavailable\n')
    argv=['python3','scripts/test-application-recovery.py','verify','--private',marker]
    for args,timeout,success in [(argv,False,False),(argv,True,False),(argv,False,True),(['docker','inspect',marker],False,False)]:
        ns['subprocess']=FakeProcess(timeout,success)
        try:
            value=ns['call'](args)
            assert success and value==b'UNCHANGED_SUCCESS'
        except RuntimeError as error:
            assert not timeout and not success and str(error)=='Application recovery command failed'
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            assert timeout
        if args is argv and not success:
            assert json.loads(path.read_text())['cause']==('COMMAND_TIMEOUT' if timeout else 'ENDPOINT_UNAVAILABLE');path.unlink()
        else:assert not path.exists()
    assert marker==target.read_text()
print(json.dumps({'result':'PASS','exact_classifier_cases':len(cases),'timeout':True,'existing_file_and_nofollow':True,'failure_and_success_preserved':True,'non_verifier_untouched':True,'secret_marker_absent':True,'tmp_removed':not work.exists()}))
